questions: Q1: What CLI files need PLAY updates?
Q2: Should EXECUTE remain alongside PLAY?
Q3: What deploy ordering is required?

answers.answer: Three files: (1) src/tickets/create.ts — VALID_MODES array line 13, help text line 17; (2) src/tickets/index.ts — usage text line 21, help text line 73; (3) src/docs/cli-content.ts — mode table line 109, example line 247, description line 250. Mode validation normalizes to uppercase and checks inclusion — no structural change needed.
evidence: create.ts lines 79-87: uppercase normalize + includes check
cli-content.ts lines 109, 247, 250: mode docs in 3 locations

answers.answer: No. Replace EXECUTE with PLAY. Zero production tickets use EXECUTE. Ticket says 'replaces execute'. No backward compat needed.
Server deploys first. CLI sends mode to POST /api/tickets — server validates against platformConfig.allowedModes. If CLI sends PLAY before server recognizes it, server returns 400.
evidence: create.ts line 147: mode sent in POST body

statement: CLI is the smallest change: replace EXECUTE with PLAY in VALID_MODES, help text, and docs across 3 files. Server must deploy first. Only needed at MVP-1.
